entry_0.title: General Leevon
entry_0.text:
General Polis Leevon was a famed and highly decorated general of the Darran Kingdom. General Leevon was arrested for treason after it was discovered that he was feeding the Zegallan Army troop movements, leading to hundreds of casualties. General Leevon is a giant of a man who wields a lance said to have been forged from dragon bone and commands lightning magic like an archmage.
Appearance: giant of a man, heavily built, greying hair, weathered face, Darran general's plate stripped of honours, dragon-bone lance.

entry_1.title: Lord Javon Nightriver
entry_1.text:
Lord Javon Nightriver is the Patriarch of the Nightriver Great House. Javon is an older man and a respected war hero of the first war against the Zegallan Empire. Javon is renowned for his battlemage fighting style which is said to be emulated by battlemages across the kingdom. Javon has short white hair, a white beard, green eyes, and a tall build with a scar on his cheek. Javon is said to be one of the most powerful mages in the Kingdom and some rumors suggest Javon is the reason the Darran Kingdom didn't lose the last war against the Zegallan Empire.
Appearance: older human man, tall, short

Appearance: young man, lean human, short brown hair, light brown eyes, dark brown leather armor with pauldrons and vambraces, crossed chest straps, wide leather belt, dark undershirt, swept-hilt steel rapier.

reply.text:
The fog comes first, red and thick, pouring out of the trees until the torches on the far wall are only smudges.

Then the screeching starts, from everywhere at once.

The first Screecher comes over the palisade on all fours, one arm hanging by a strip of skin. It does not seem to notice. An arrow takes it in the chest and it keeps coming.

To the left a conscript screams as claws open his thigh. Halena drags him back from the parapet and shoves a spear into the gap.

Below the wall a Screecher falls, and falls apart: it bubbles into the mud like wax, and where it lay a scatter of white flowers opens in the dark.

Somewhere down the line a defender stops shooting and stares into the fog, and the thing climbing toward him has a face he knows.

The fog is still thick, and dawn is hours away.

entry_0.title: Adventurer Rank
entry_0.text: Adventurers are ranked by the guild to determine what kind of quests they can handle. An adventurer is ranked from the lowest rank of F to the highest rank of A. The lower the rank of a quest, the lower the rewards and vice versa. In order for an Adventurer to rank up, they must take a promotion exam - usually a quest of the rank they are trying to rank up to. Most Adventurers end up staying at D-Rank, where the quests aren't too difficult and pay well.

entry_1.title: Bashima - Goddess of Travelers and the Hearth
entry_1.text:
Bashima is the Goddess of Travelers and the Hearth, whose followers explore the world and tend to homes as per Bashima's holy edict that every wanderer should have a proper place to rest their head. Bashima is often depicted as a six-armed woman carrying different tools in her hands. Bashima's symbol is a blazing staff and followers typically carry a wooden token or walking cane as a mark of faith.
Appearance: depicted as a six-armed woman in travelling robes, each hand holding a different road or household tool, hearth-flame halo.

entry_2.title: Dalan Evergreen
entry_2.text:
Dalan Evergreen is a short, feminine, male elf adventurer. Dalan is registered at the Aegis City Adventurers Guild as a "Ranger."  Dalan is amazing with a bow, hates being called cute, and has his own 'fan club' which has apparently sworn to protect him. Dalan is friends with Ellie and Jasira. Dalan is a member of the Evergreen Tribe of Elves which are located in Duskwallow Forest.
Appearance: young adult man, short slender elf, messy blonde hair with side braid, pointed ears, green hooded capelet and tunic, white undershirt, brown leather belts, brown gloves, wooden longbow.

entry_3.title: Dwarf
entry_3.text:
Dwarves are stout folk, usually only about 4 feet tall. Dwarves tend to live in mountainous areas and are great crafters. Dwarves famously get along with most races and make the most loyal of friends. Dwarves obsess over their honor and are known to keep grudges for life.
Appearance: Stout humanoids about four feet tall, broad muscular build, thick braided beards, sturdy boots, heavy plate or chain armor, axes and smithing hammers.

entry_4.title: Elves
entry_4.text:
Elves are a reclusive race who have only recently begun to integrate into human societies. Elves are tall, lithe, beautiful, and able to live hundreds of years. Elves have darkvision.
Appearance: Tall, lithe, graceful humanoids, long pointed ears, fine elegant features, smooth fair skin, flowing hair, forest-toned leathers or fine robes, longbows common.

entry_5.title: Fiana Deulana - Barmaid for the Adventurers Guild
entry_5.text:
Fiana Deulana is a young woman who works in the Adventurers Guild's Tavern at Aegis City. Fiana has short, curly red hair, huge breasts, freckles, blue eyes, and is about average height. Fiana is known for being an extrovert, often drinking with adventurers. Fiana is one of the "Jewels of the Guild" in Aegis City according to fanclubs.
Appearance: young woman, human, shoulder-length red hair, white maid headdress, blue eyes, black puff-sleeved bolero, blue and red corset dress with bow and blue gem brooch.

entry_6.title: Rydel Deulana - Bartender for the Adventurers Guild
entry_6.text:
Rydel Deulana is a male beastfolk with dog heritage, blue hair, green eyes, and a tall build. Rydel is Fiana's adopted brother. Rydel works as the bartender at the Aegis City Adventurers Guild Tavern and is well-liked by the patrons who visit because of his charming and earnest demeanor. Rydel is considered one of the "Jewels of the Adventurers Guild."
Appearance: adult man, dog beastfolk, floppy blue dog ears, long messy blue hair, green eyes, white open-collar shirt, dark teal vest, silver chain necklace with pendant.

entry_0.title: Dwarf
entry_0.text:
Dwarves are stout folk, usually only about 4 feet tall. Dwarves tend to live in mountainous areas and are great crafters. Dwarves famously get along with most races and make the most loyal of friends. Dwarves obsess over their honor and are known to keep grudges for life.
Appearance: Stout humanoids about four feet tall, broad muscular build, thick braided beards, sturdy boots, heavy plate or chain armor, axes and smithing hammers.

entry_1.title: Manako the Shrine Maiden
entry_1.text:
Manako Rypanor is a female cow girl shrine maiden in charge of the Rypanor Shrine located in Aegis City's Temple District. Manako has long black hair, blue eyes, cow ears and horns, and a massive bust. Manako worships the flame spirit Furabi. Manako is known in Aegis City for being good with children and people often leave their kids at the shrine for Manako to look after them.
Appearance: young woman, cow beastfolk, small cow horns, spotted cow ears with ear tag, cow tail, long black hair with blunt bangs, blue eyes, white-and-black cowprint kimono, red sash bow.

entry_2.title: Witch
entry_2.text:
A witch is a human woman that signed a deal with a devil to serve in hell after their death in exchange for magical powers. This supernaturally extends the witch's lifespan. Witches are hunted by the Inquisition for heresy. Witches often form covens of multiple witches for safety.
Appearance: adult woman, human, witch, coven, occult trappings.

entry_4.title: Eriana Valtara
entry_4.text:
Lady Eriana Valtara is the Duchess of the Valtara Noble Family, one of the Darran Kingdoms noble families. She is a Beastfolk with Jerboa traits such as rabbit-like ears, golden eyes, and long blonde hair. She's known as one of Aegis City's most accomplished composers and musicians.
Appearance: adult woman, jerboa-kin beastfolk, large rabbit-like ears, long tufted tail, long straight blonde hair, golden eyes, black lace veil, black corset gown with puffed sleeves, white violin.

entry_5.title: Lord Javon Nightriver
entry_5.text:
Lord Javon Nightriver is the Patriarch of the Nightriver Great House. Javon is an older man and a respected war hero of the first war against the Zegallan Empire. Javon is renowned for his battlemage fighting style which is said to be emulated by battlemages across the kingdom. Javon has short white hair, a white beard, green eyes, and a tall build with a scar on his cheek. Javon is said to be one of the most powerful mages in the Kingdom and some rumors suggest Javon is the reason the Darran Kingdom didn't lose the last war against the Zegallan Empire.
Appearance: older human man, tall, short

entry_6.title: Natalia Nightriver
entry_6.text:
Lady Natalia Nightriver is the daughter of Lord Javon Nightriver. Natalia has Long brown hair, large breasts, a short stature, and green eyes. Natalia is known as a 'weird' and 'unsettling' woman who seems to struggle with her magic. Natalia is supposedly betrothed to the Bertoanal heir: Kippon Bertoanal.
Appearance: young woman, short human, long light brown hair in high ponytail, small black tiara, green eyes, pale skin, emerald earrings, white gold-trimmed gown, emerald brooch, white fur-collared cape.

entry_4.title: Deep - The Tear Over the Altar
entry_4.text: [What happened at Carrow Keep. Lord Aldric Carrow bought branded captives from the Beastmen of Nahalbuk under his keep and bled them on his altar to tear a hole in the planes and call a demon to make him immortal. It came, and ate him. His armoured guards were changed by it: inky tentacles through the joints of their plate, no longer men. The tear above the altar still weeps violet light and demon-reek, and it has been smelled from very far below.]

entry_5.text: [Unira Windsor, a short, strong young human woman with long silver hair and dark red eyes, a Fighter of the Aegis City Guild listed as dead. A middle child of the Windsor family, who serve House Nightriver; she ran away to adventure with sword and shield. Reserved, slow to trust, kind, quick to cuss, sure she is never good enough. Terrified of Beastmen since her captivity; a blade scar on her left arm.]

entry_6.title: Deep - Nahalbuk and the Brand
entry_6.text: [Dungeon Nahalbuk is a new dungeon under Carrow Keep, home to a Beastmen tribe whose shaman sold captives up the stair. Before a sacrifice, captives receive the Tahanna Brand, a trident with a coiled snake, set on the soul: the branded must stay near the brand's owner and obey their commands, resisting only at great pain, and cannot speak of the brand or harm the owner. It glows purple while a command is working. Removing it usually kills. If the owner is killed, the brand passes to the killer.]

entry_7.title: Deep - Unira's Truth
entry_7.text: [What Unira told. Her party, the Wind Ballad (Kallan, a human fighter she had feelings for; Fulanie, a half-elf ice mage; Mallow, a halfling cleric of Boher), took a D-rank scouting job into Nahalbuk when it was new and were overrun by Beastmen. Mallow said to leave her behind, Kallan shoved her into the horde and Fulanie froze her boots to the floor. They reported to the Guild that she volunteered to hold the line and died. She was captured and branded instead.]
